assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md

`sortAnswers` in src/rank-tickets.ts turns each candidate's `noul` probability into `{ ticketId, probability }` and sorts with `.sort((a, b) => b.probability - a.probability)`, so the model returns per-candidate scores and never an ordering.

`rankDuplicateTickets` always returns a full ranked list, with no threshold, no none option and no duplicate/no-duplicate flag; the README only says 'A first-place result can still be a poor match' and leaves thresholds to future calibration, so no code path concludes that no candidate is a duplicate (the only special case is zero candidates).
